gloss: a certain place; an undisclosed location

definitions.gloss: a certain place; an undisclosed location
definitions.explanation: Used to refer to a place whose name is deliberately withheld, whether for privacy, suspense, or because the specific location is unimportant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧{某所|ぼうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: We met at a certain place in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {某所|ぼうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{隠|かく}れ{家|が}→隠れ家：16379_kakurega⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a hidden restaurant at an undisclosed location.

examples.japanese: ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{某所|ぼうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I heard that the filming took place at a certain location in the Kanto region.

notes:
Frequently used in media, blogs, and casual storytelling to create an air of mystery or simply to keep a location anonymous. Often preceded by a broad area name: ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧{某所|ぼうしょ} (somewhere in Tokyo), ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧{某所|ぼうしょ} (somewhere in Kansai).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{都内|とない}→都内：19144_tonai⟧{某所|ぼうしょ}: somewhere in Tokyo
- ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧{某所|ぼうしょ}: somewhere in Kanto
- {某所|ぼうしょ}⟦にて→〜にて：21803_nite⟧: at a certain place (formal)
- {某所|ぼうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}する→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧: to film at an undisclosed location

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{某社|ぼうしゃ}→某社：26014_bousha⟧: a certain company — the business counterpart in the ⟦{某|ぼう}→某：19351_bou⟧〜 series
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧: somewhere — the everyday, casual equivalent
- とある⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: a certain place — similar nuance but slightly more conversational
